sections.heading: Your first expedition
sections.body: Lumo Ruins is your first normal combat area. Starting combat creates an ongoing action rather than a single training encounter.

sections.heading: Combat continues
sections.body: Your character keeps resolving encounters over time until you stop the action. After each victory, your equipped tool can automatically gather its matching resource. Lumo Ruins is abundant in Mining, Woodcutting, and Skinning, granting +50% yield to all three.

sections.heading: Completing First Steps
sections.body: Start the Lumo Ruins expedition to complete First Steps and unlock normal Shenic combat areas. Return to Combat to inspect both battle and gathering results.
